title: Reader: In-app browser preview hides/cuts important elements
body: When you preview a post from the Reader using the 🌏 icon, you get a preview of the site itself. However, some elements (especially fixed ones like cookie-related banners) are hidden behind the bottom bar and cannot be used. ### Expected behavior To be able to access all the elements from the in-app preview. ### Actual behavior The bottom overlay bar gets on top of important elements like the button to accept/deny cookies: https://zerowastechef.com/ | https://rafaelfunchal.com.br/ | https://toddhensonphotography.com/ ------------ | ------------- | ------------- | | ### Steps to reproduce the behavior 1. Open the Reader 2. Open a post from a site with one of these bottom banners. Examples: https://toddhensonphotography.com/blog, https://zerowastechef.com/, or https://rafaelfunchal.com.br/ 3. Tap the globe icon to preview the site 4. Check the bottom ##### Tested on iPhone 7, iOS 14.4, WPiOS 16.8.0.4 Reported also in 3826878-zen
author: Participant 1
